content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

NOWPayments is built for the people that traditional payment gateways like Stripe and PayPal have locked out. With a 0.5% fee structure and no KYC requirements, it's the perfect solution for creators who need to receive payments in cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron or Solana. The infrastructure is designed to be modular, with a focus on scalability and customizability. This means you can tailor your payment and delivery pipeline to meet your specific needs, whether that's fast and cheap USDT payments or automatic conversions to local currencies like naira in Nigeria or Ghanaian cedis in Ghana.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can set up a NOWPayments digital store, you'll need a few things. First, you'll need to choose a blockchain network with low fees, such as Tron or Solana. You'll also need to select a cryptocurrency like USDT, which is widely accepted and has fast settlement times. Additionally, you'll need to set up a Supabase or Google Sheets database to store your orders, and a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 bucket for delivering your digital products. With these components in place, you're ready to deploy your NOWPayments digital store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you've got your components set up, it's time to configure your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves integrating your NOWPayments account with your Supabase or Google Sheets database, and your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 bucket. You'll also need to set up automatic webhook notifications to ensure that your store is always up-to-date with the latest transactions. With your pipeline configured, you're ready to start receiving payments from your customers.
NOWPayments has a 0.5% fee structure, making it one of the most cost-effective payment gateways on the market.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your payment and delivery pipeline set up, it's time to go live with your NOWPayments digital store. This involves deploying your store to a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and configuring your DNS settings to point to your new store. Once your store is live, you can start processing transactions and receiving payments in cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron. Just remember to test your store thoroughly before going live to ensure that everything is working as expected.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows and you start to receive more transactions, you may need to scale your infrastructure to ensure that it can handle the increased load. This involves upgrading your hosting platform, configuring caching and load balancing, and optimizing your database and delivery pipeline for performance. With the Complete Builder Kit, you'll have everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, including all 6 blueprints and 7 templates.

How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal? USDT payments on Tron or Solana take just a few minutes to settle, thanks to the fast and reliable nature of these blockchain networks. In contrast, PayPal payments can take several days to clear, depending on the sender's location and the recipient's bank's processing times.
USDT on Tron or Solana takes just a few minutes to settle, making it ideal for fast and reliable transactions.

You can also find more resources and guides on our products page: https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Additionally, if you're looking for a P2P exchange that supports Bitcoin to naira conversions, you may want to check out Binance's Patricia exchange.
Your Deployment Checklist

To set up a NOWPayments digital store, follow these steps: First, choose a blockchain network with low fees, such as Tron or Solana. Next, select a cryptocurrency like USDT, which is widely accepted and has fast settlement times. Then, set up a Supabase or Google Sheets database to store your orders, and a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 bucket for delivering your digital products. Finally, deploy your store to a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and configure your DNS settings to point to your new store. Don't forget to test your store thoroughly before going live to ensure that everything is working as expected.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up automatic webhook notifications in NOWPayments?

To set up automatic webhook notifications in NOWPayments, you'll need to configure your store to send webhooks to your Supabase or Google Sheets database whenever a transaction is made. This will ensure that your store is always up-to-date with the latest transactions and that you can respond to customer inquiries in a timely manner.
Can I use NOWPayments with other blockchain networks besides Tron and Solana?

Yes, NOWPayments supports a wide range of blockchain networks, including Ethereum, Binance Smart Chain, and Polkadot. However, if you're looking for fast and cheap transactions, Tron and Solana are still your best bets.
How do I convert Bitcoin to naira in Nigeria?

You can convert Bitcoin to naira in Nigeria using a P2P exchange like Binance's Patricia exchange. Simply deposit your Bitcoin into the exchange, then withdraw the equivalent amount in naira. Note that exchange rates and fees may apply.
Can I use NOWPayments to receive payments in other cryptocurrencies besides USDT?
Yes, NOWPayments supports a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including BTC, ETH, and LTC. However, if you're looking for fast and reliable transactions, USDT on Tron or Solana is still your best bet.
How do I set up a Supabase or Google Sheets database to store my orders?

To set up a Supabase or Google Sheets database to store your orders, you'll need to create a new database and configure it to accept data from your NOWPayments account. This will ensure that your orders are accurately recorded and that you can respond to customer inquiries in a timely manner.
